purpose: Freeze one-way production ownership for Hero-Soldier membership after Stage C-3. Relation semantics are owned by the accepted A-stage canonical relation layer; indexes and final Hero/Soldier consumers are derived offline; frontend code may consume final materialized IDs but must not recompute or reinterpret membership.

canonicalRelation.writePolicy: Only the offline accepted relation-generation pipeline may create or replace relation membership. Downstream consumers are read-only with respect to canonical membership.

allowed: Read stable Hero IDs and final Hero soldiers.ids membership from final Hero consumer output.
Read stable Soldier IDs/site IDs and final Soldier heroes.finalHeroIds membership from final Soldier consumer output.
Resolve display metadata after identity has already been resolved by stable IDs.
Build Hero-to-Soldier and Soldier-to-Hero navigation from final materialized membership IDs.
Render missing Korean names, release dates or assets as presentation state without altering relation membership.
forbidden: Read raw ConfigData to determine Hero-Soldier membership at runtime or build time in frontend source.
Import canonicalRelation, byHeroIndex or bySoldierIndex directly into frontend source as an alternate membership owner.
Reconstruct membership from BASE_SOLDIER_HERO, SP_HERO_REWARD, SP_SOLDIER_INHERIT, SP_SOLDIER_EXPAND, GetSoldierHeros_ID, SecondStageRewardSoldiers or SecondStageExpandHeroList semantics.
Infer SP Soldier membership by adding or subtracting 5000 or any other ID arithmetic.
Join Hero and Soldier membership by Korean/Chinese/English display names or other presentation strings.
Patch one consumer from the other consumer when a mismatch is found; mismatches must fail validation and return to the owning upstream pipeline.
Add arbitrary pair-specific exceptions in route/component code.

staticGate.blockedIdArithmetic: Hero/Soldier integration frontend source must not contain membership logic that adds or subtracts 5000 to translate normal/SP Soldier IDs.

nonBlockingPresentationReview.policy: Presentation/localization/release/asset incompleteness remains REVIEW-only and cannot mutate stable membership IDs.

completionRule: C-4 passes only when C-0 through C-3 remain accepted and frozen, all five production layers point to the frozen artifacts above, one-way ownership is explicit, and the frontend source tree contains no blocked raw-relation imports or detected Hero/Soldier membership recomputation signatures.
